evidence.detail: Exact-v308 class owns one data RandomAccessFile, one index RandomAccessFile, a store id and a 520-byte sector buffer; index entries are six bytes and data sectors carry the classic eight-byte header plus up to 512 payload bytes.
Read/write methods validate file id, chunk number, next sector and store id, then follow/allocate linked 520-byte sectors.
Classic 317 source names the byte-for-byte equivalent cache sector store Decompressor, with the same RandomAccessFile constructor and 520/512-byte format.

candidates.note: Pinned SpawnPK v308 cache-sector implementation is primary authority; historical source corroborates the inherited name.

evidence.detail: Exact-v308 base node stores a long key plus previous/next Node links and unlinks itself by splicing those primary links.
NodeList uses this exact type as its sentinel and iteration element; NodeSub extends it directly.
Classic client source exposes the same keyed primary doubly-linked element as Node.

candidates.note: Name is fixed by primary linked-node contract and classic lineage.

OnDemandData extends this class, matching the classic secondary-list request-node hierarchy.
Classic 317 source names the structurally identical Node subclass NodeSub and exposes prevNodeSub/nextNodeSub plus unlinkSub().

evidence.detail: Exact-v308 class owns a sentinel Node and supports head/tail insertion, pop, forward iteration, reverse iteration and full unlink/clear behavior.

Classic clients expose the same sentinel-node queue/deque helper as NodeList, including insert and forward/reverse traversal semantics.
